_note: Daily-bar moving-average pullback strategy (course ep.10). Tag: UPTREND only. Disabled by default - run isolated with `trader backtest --strategy pullback_ma --start ... --end ... --label pullback_ma_only`.

exit._note: Trails the SLOWER trend SMA (matches entry.trend_sma_period), not the fast pullback_sma_period entry was keyed to - entry and exit were previously the SAME fast MA, which gets re-touched on every subsequent shallow dip as the stock keeps advancing, causing short/choppy exits. Trailing the slower trend MA instead lets ordinary pullbacks pass and only exits when the broader uptrend itself actually breaks.
